colin-d-hernandez.text: Top priorities: Medicare for All (CalCare), universal childcare, and housing for all. "There's absolutely no reason why we cannot guarantee healthcare to every single person in this state."

source.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Member of the State Assembly, District 51

colin-d-hernandez.text: On housing: "Undo single family zoning laws and redlining to allow for multifamily housing to be built. Housing density is key to making California affordable and walkable." Also wants to build social housing for unhoused neighbors.

source.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Member of the State Assembly, District 51

colin-d-hernandez.text: Pledges to repeal the Costa-Hawkins Act and the Ellis Act, enact more tenant protections, restrict private equity in housing, and institute vacancy taxes per empty unit.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Will push legislation creating social housing to place people into permanent housing with services such as mental health evaluations and substance rehabilitation: "No more temporary fixes or half-measures."

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Supports raising taxes on billionaires and the largest corporations; "full support" for the Billionaire Wealth Tax; will fight to reform Prop 13 and close corporate loopholes.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Calls to "Abolish ICE"; says officers who actively collaborate with ICE or the National Guard should be relieved from duty; supports more funding for legal counsel for people facing deportation.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Will vote against bills allowing new oil or gas leases for on- or offshore drilling and supports more renewable energy investment and no corporate subsidies for oil and gas.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Supports community-based alternatives to policing and incarceration, and opposes adding police or armed guards on school campuses in favor of trained mental health professionals.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Will fight to ensure Prop 98 dollars stay with public schools; supports voting yes on Prop 3 for public school funding; opposes AB 715; wants tuition-free public college and vocational schools.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: "I will always vote and legislate to increase housing density, robust public transit, and safer bike lanes."

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: "I will always support queer and trans rights"; promises legislation advancing LGBTQ+ and trans, gender-expansive and intersex protections, and says any CalCare must cover comprehensive care for LGBTQ+ people.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Says he will legislate to divest CalPERS and CalSTRS funds from Israeli-linked entities and opposes AB 715, the law limiting advocacy in K-12 classrooms, as censoring teachers.

source.title: Issues - Colin Hernandez for California Assembly

colin-d-hernandez.text: Does not take donations from corporations or super PACs, relying on small-dollar donors. Endorsed by UCLA's Young Democratic Socialists of America.
